summary: Public projects created on 17 October 2025: 5 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: A batch of repositories covers disclosure and setup: a footer badge for AI friendliness, notes on backing up cloud services, pipx install scripts for Ubuntu, a notice for vibe coded projects, and a tool that turns voice recordings into blog posts. A Tel Aviv photo dataset rounds out the work.

projects.name: Back Up Your SaaS
projects.description: Notes for fellow cautious trusters of "the cloud"

projects.name: Ubuntu Pipx Toolbox
projects.description: Bash scripts for installing a few useful tool groups on Ubuntu with pipx

projects.name: Vibe Coded Disclosure
projects.description: Quick utility for adding FYI type notices to repos that they were vibe coded

projects.name: Voice Blog Creator
projects.description: Create a blog (or other doc) from a voice recording

projects.name: Tel Aviv Pics
projects.description: This dataset contains 53 high-quality photographs of Tel Aviv's urban environment, captured to serve as reference material for game development, 3D world creation, and digital environment design.
